summary: Task 3 establishes the platform-wide isolation primitive (ProjectService.requireOwned) cleanly: anti-enumeration parity holds across all five paths, mass-assignment defense is doubled at DTO + response-record + service-layer ownerId injection, Decision 14 deletedAt-FIRST guard is correctly ordered before quota/name-conflict/save, and AC-T7 zero-touch is verified via git diff (only the 5 declared files changed). All Mongo access is via Spring Data derived finders — no NoSQL injection vector. CSRF and auth-gate enforcement are confirmed by IT including a bare-client unauthenticated probe across all five verb shapes. No findings.
non_findings: A01 Broken Access Control — requireOwned (ProjectService.java:50-64) collapses foreign / soft-deleted-without-flag / missing / malformed-ObjectId / IllegalArgumentException all to identical AppException.notFound('Project not found'). Verified by 6 unit assertions in ProjectServiceTest (requireOwned_*) and 12 IT assertions across getProject_/patchProject_/deleteProject_/restoreProject_*foreignId|malformedId|softDeletedOwnId* — every state-changing verb has parity coverage.

A01 Decision 14 deletedAt-FIRST guard — ProjectService.java:160-162 errors with 404 BEFORE countByOwnerIdAndDeletedAtIsNull (line 163), BEFORE the name-conflict findByOwnerIdAndNameAndIdNotAndDeletedAtIsNull (line 170), and BEFORE projectRepository.save (line 182). Both restore_onActiveProject_throws404AndDoesNotEmitRenameOrRestore (unit) and restoreProject_onActiveProject_returns404AndDoesNotEmitRenameOrRestoreEvent (IT) confirm zero project_renamed and zero project_restored events fire — meaning a foreign-but-active ID leaked to an attacker reveals NO observable state change.

A01 ownerId provenance — ProjectController.java:42, 52, 59, 71, 81, 91 all source ownerId via currentUserId() (lines 125-131), which is a byte-identical copy of ProfileController.java:75-81. ownerId is never read from request body, query string, or path variable. currentUserId() also acts as a defense-in-depth auth gate: missing/unauthenticated principal yields AppException.unauthorized even if the SecurityWebFilter ever misrouted.

A04 Mass-assignment (Risk R2) — controller binds @Valid @RequestBody CreateProjectRequest / UpdateProjectRequest only; the entity Project is never bound. CreateProjectRequest.java:11 and UpdateProjectRequest.java:12 carry @JsonIgnoreProperties(ignoreUnknown=true). ProjectService.create lines 84-91 manually constructs the entity and only ever calls p.setOwnerId(ownerId) with the authenticated ownerId. ProjectResponse record (ProjectResponse.java:7-15) has no ownerId member — structurally impossible to leak. IT postProject_hostileBodyWithOwnerId_* asserts both DB ownerId == authenticated user (saved.getOwnerId().equals(USER_ID)) AND response $.ownerId.doesNotExist() AND zero documents land on OTHER_USER_ID. All five response paths (GET-list / GET-one / POST / PATCH / DELETE / RESTORE) assert $.ownerId.doesNotExist() in IT.

A03 Injection — zero raw Mongo construction. grep -n 'Criteria|@Query|Aggregation' across ProjectService/ProjectController/ProjectRepository returns no matches. All access is via Spring Data derived-finder methods (findByOwnerIdAndNameAndDeletedAtIsNull, countByOwnerIdAndDeletedAtIsNull, findByOwnerIdAndNameAndIdNotAndDeletedAtIsNull, etc.) which Spring Data parametrizes via the BSON document builder. AC-T11 satisfied.

A05 / AC-T7 zero-touch — git diff 8cd8ce6~1..8cd8ce6 --name-only returns exactly the 5 declared files. SecurityConfig.java, JobRunrMongoConfig.java, EventService.java, AbstractIntegrationTest.java, and frontend auth.global.ts are all untouched.

A08 PATCH normalization (ProjectController.java:100-111 + ProjectService.java:198-217) — three-way semantics is correct: name blank→null (no change, drops blank to avoid AC-12b false-collide), timezone blank→null (no change — does NOT clobber existing), description blank preserved as blank, service applyDescription maps blank→null (clear). IT patchProject_blankTimezone_doesNotOverwriteExistingTimezone confirms the existing 'Europe/Kyiv' survives a blank-timezone PATCH, and patchProject_blankDescription_setsDbDescriptionToNull confirms blank-description does clear.

A09 Logging — every mutation emits via EventService.logEvent (ProjectService.java:94-96, 126-134, 147-149, 184-191). EventService.java:22-27 is fire-and-forget (.subscribe(null, err -> log.error(...))) so a logging failure cannot abort the request. Metadata uses typed values only — projectId, name, previousName (Strings already validated to ≤50 chars by DTO @Size), and renamedDueToConflict (boolean). No raw user-controlled blobs reach the audit log. Renamed events carry both 'previousName' and 'name' for forensic delta; restore events conditionally carry 'renamedDueToConflict' only when the suffix was applied.

CSRF — every IT state-changing call uses .mutateWith(csrf()). The bare-client probe anyEndpoint_unauthenticatedBareClient_returns401 confirms POST/PATCH/DELETE/POST-restore all return is4xxClientError (either 401 auth or 403 CSRF) — request never reaches the controller. SecurityConfig.java:55-65 CSRF protection on /api/** is inherited; no per-controller override.

Auth gate ordering — SecurityConfig.java:71 pathMatchers('/api/**').authenticated() fires before the controller. AbstractIntegrationTest.java:81-86 rebinds webTestClient to bindToApplicationContext (no default csrf or auth mutator), so the bare-client GETs return a hard 401 — confirmed for both /api/v1/projects and /api/v1/projects/any-id.

Information disclosure — ProjectResponse.java:7-15 has 7 fields (id, name, description, timezone, createdAt, updatedAt, deletedAt). No ownerId member — assertion $.ownerId.doesNotExist() is structural, not configuration-dependent. Slice test ProjectControllerSliceTest:60 + IT tests on every verb response shape lock this contract.

Decision 8 (no rate limit on /api/v1/projects/*) — re-examined for new vectors: (a) audit-log spam is bounded by the 5-active-project quota — an attacker can issue at most 5 create-events + N patch/delete/restore-events before hitting CODE_PROJECT_LIMIT_REACHED; (b) timing-oracle for ID enumeration: malformed-ObjectId returns synchronously via IllegalArgumentException mapping while foreign/missing/own-soft-deleted paths do a DB round-trip — but ObjectId hex strings are 96-bit unguessable, making this oracle non-exploitable. No new vector found that Decision 8 did not consider.

Defense-in-depth note (informational, not a finding): extractIp() at ProjectController.java:138-148 trusts X-Forwarded-For unconditionally — identical to the pre-existing pattern in AuthService.java:643 and ProfileController.java:89. AuthService:639 already documents the platform-wide assumption that production must front the app with a sanitizing proxy. Not introduced by this task; flagging here would require flagging the existing code in the same review pass.
